text:
Maria: quick accessibility pass on export + corr-id in the trace header — two small but high-impact fixes. screenshot in figma.
Ajay: can you bullet them so we can triage?
Maria: sure:
• export CTA disappears into "More" on narrow widths and becomes hard to reach by keyboard.
• corr-id copy button has no aria-label, and on mobile the copy button is before the id so SR says "button" then the id.
• download filename is generic (trace.json) — users expect trace+date+id when snapshots are bundled.
Taylor: noted. On mobile we render actions into overflow to save space. which ones should we keep visible?
Maria: keep Export visible longer, hide Share first. if super narrow, show icon-only with aria-label rather than hiding entirely.
Sam: a11y specifics from testing:
• copy button: aria-label="Copy correlation id 0a1b2c"; DOM order: id text first, then button.
• export: if direct download, don't use aria-haspopup; if opens menu, use aria-haspopup and role=menu.
• announce completion via aria-live: "Trace export ready: trace-20260323-0a1b2c.zip".
Taylor: backend currently returns Content-Disposition: filename="trace.json". we'll change to include corr id + .zip for multi-file exports and add X-Trace-Filename header so frontend can precompute name.
Ajay: analytics: keep event stable. emit trace.export with props {source: "header", format: "zip", corr_id: "0a1b2c"}.
Maria: copy suggestions:
• Export CTA text: "Export trace (.zip)" when multiple files, else "Export trace (JSON)".
• Filename pattern: trace-<corrid>-YYYYMMDD.zip.
Taylor: implementation notes:
• header: CSS grid with min-width for actions, swap DOM order for corr-id + copy on small screens.
• more menu: add roving tabindex + arrow key support.
• add unit tests for keyboard nav + axe checks.
Maria: will update figma + i18n keys (export.trace.zip = "Export trace (.zip)", copy.corr = "Copy correlation id {id}"). opening PR for copy + markup.
Taylor: i'll open frontend PR for header/CSS and backend PR for Content-Disposition. will link in PR description and add tests.
Ajay: assign to eng-platform & eng-runtime, labels: a11y, ux, release: patch.
Deploy-bot: Reminder: add changelog line when PRs merge. :robot_face:
Maria: PR opened: https://git.redwood/test/merge/7890 — requesting a11y review.
Alex: small changes but big win for keyboard & screen reader users. :thumbsup:
